## Current objective
Fix the nightly reconciliation job in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`, which is double-counting refunds. The avatar CDN migration and Tenacity refactor are paused, not superseded, and must not be mixed into the reconciliation fix.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Reconciliation target: `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`
- Staging database: `db-stg-2.internal`; `db-stg-1` is superseded as decommissioned/read-only.
- `config/staging.yaml` is stale; do not use its database host.
- Avatar source: `/srv/app/avatars`
- Avatar manifest: `/var/tmp/avatars.tsv`
- Avatar destination: `s3://cdn-prod-user-avatars/`
- Avatar archive: `snapshots/avatars-pre-cdn-20250308.tgz`
- Avatar count: `18,432`
- Request context: `current_request_id` in `ledgerly/middleware.py`
- Logging formatter fields: `service`, `level`, `message`, `request_id`

## Ruled-out approaches
- Increasing Celery visibility timeout to six hours: hid stuck jobs and did not fix duplicates.
- Legacy SQLAlchemy `Query.filter_by()` pagination: caused warnings; invoice pagination was rewritten.
- Direct `print()` for invoice IDs: replaced with structured logging.
- Do not retry the Tenacity refactor; it was explicitly stopped for now.

## Plan and progress
- [pending] Inspect refund aggregation and identify why refunds are counted twice.
- [pending] Add or update a regression test reproducing the double-count.
- [pending] Implement the smallest reconciliation fix.
- [pending] Run focused reconciliation tests, then the full suite.
- [paused] Avatar migration: manifest inspection, verification, cutover, and cleanup.
- [paused] Tenacity migration in `ledgerly/sync/client.py`.
- No reconciliation command has been issued; status is unknown.

## Recent work
Logging, billing exception handling, request-ID formatting, staging-host correction, avatar upload, and DST recurrence fixes were completed. The latest recurrence work fixed spring-DST local-time preservation and added a midnight-DST regression test. The reconciliation refund defect remains the active priority.

## Current objective
Replace the hand-rolled retry loop in `ledgerly/sync/client.py` with Tenacity. The avatar CDN migration must run separately, one ordered step at a time. Earlier PDF pagination and SQLAlchemy modernization work is complete but not the main session goal.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- PDF: `_row_height(points) = points / 72`; continuation-page budget is `page_height - 36`; invoice `1048` had 86 items, initially 3 pages.
- SQLAlchemy 2.0: use `DeclarativeBase`; invoice lookup uses `session.get(Invoice, invoice_id)`; `echo=True` was removed.
- Restricted fields: every name ending in `_secret`, `_token`, or `_fingerprint` may be copied only through `ledgerly.sanitizers.safe_customer_context`.
- Avatar source: `/srv/app/avatars`
- Manifest: `/var/tmp/avatars.tsv`
- Bucket: `s3://cdn-prod-user-avatars/`
- Archive: `snapshots/avatars-pre-cdn-20250308.tgz`
- Legacy `declarative_base()` declarations are superseded by `DeclarativeBase`.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Raw point height as a fraction of total page height: caused incorrect pagination and split totals.
- Reserving the table header repeatedly per page: overconstrained page height.
- Function-based `declarative_base()` and `Invoice.query.get()`: legacy SQLAlchemy APIs.
- Passing `echo=True` to SQLAlchemy 2.0 `create_engine`: removed option.

## Plan and progress
- Tenacity retry migration: pending.
- PDF fixes/tests: done (`14 passed, 1 skipped`; billing `83 passed, 4 skipped`).
- SQLAlchemy cleanup/tests: done so far (`19 passed`; full baseline `148 passed, 2 skipped`).
- Avatar migration steps 1–8: pending; no command has been issued, so status is unknown.
- Next exact command: `pg_isready -d app_production && find /srv/app/avatars -type f \( -name '*.png' -o -name '*.jpg' \) | wc -l`

## Recent work
PDF pagination was corrected without golden-PDF changes. SQLAlchemy legacy declarations, invoice lookup, and engine configuration were modernized. Work stopped while reviewing scoped-session lifecycle; `expire_on_commit=True` remains unchanged.
